company.name: Decentro
company.shortDescription: Decentro is an API banking platform that provides modular APIs and SDKs for integrating financial products
company.description: Decentro is a full‑stack API banking platform that simplifies financial product integration through modular APIs and SDKs. It offers payment capabilities—including virtual accounts, UPI gateway, recurring payments, instant payouts, escrow accounts, ledgers—and banking services like KYC, identity verification, data aggregation, and fraud detection tools. Businesses use the platform to integrate, develop, and deploy fintech offerings quickly by leveraging pre‑built modules that abstract away direct bank integrations and compliance tasks. Its developer hub provides thorough documentation, sandbox environments, and clear guides to support onboarding across its payment and banking modules.
